# Pull Request

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do? Why is it needed? Link any related issues. -->

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] chore — tooling / infra / dependencies
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] test — adds or fixes tests
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] breaking — contains a breaking change

## Areas touched

- [ ] `apps/` (dashboard / docs / explorer)
- [ ] `packages/` (sdk / ui / config / shared-types)
- [ ] `services/` (FastAPI / Rust)
- [ ] `contracts/` (Solidity)
- [ ] `infra/` or `deploy/`
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm type-check` pass locally
- [ ] `cargo build --workspace` passes (if Rust touched)
- [ ] `forge build && forge test` passes (if Solidity touched)
- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / `docs/` where relevant
- [ ] Added a changeset (if a published package changed)
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, or `.env` values committed
